ns2:course.label: Volleyball Band
ns2:course.description: Prepares and performs music of the highest available quality for volleyball games. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation. Completion of course involves, in addition to the regular schedule of rehearsals, participation in public performances by the band. 1 undergraduate hour. 1 graduate hour. May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: Auditions for the volleyball band take place during the first week of classes in the fall semester. Open to all students who have been accepted by audition, with assignments made according to proficiency and instrumentation.
